name: thermal-test-analyzer
description: AI-assisted analyzer for thermal imaging effectiveness test logs: anomaly summaries, regression detection, and run-vs-run comparison.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.dupcheck: npm --prefix server run dupcheck && npm --prefix web run dupcheck
